description: Persist AgentSession activity summaries at the Session write boundary and use them to serve activity cards without replaying transcript history for event summaries.

tasks.title: Persist incremental AgentSession event summaries
tasks.description: Add restart-safe activity-summary state and a pure reducer in the Session module. Apply normalized accepted Runtime observations before the existing state save so model resolution, current tool states, and paired terminal failure facts persist without depending on transcript-flush success.
acceptanceCriteria: Persisted AgentSession state exposes an empty summary when no applicable Runtime observations exist.
Accepted model, tool, and session-activity observations persist the resolved model, distinct tool count, failed tool count, and failure reason/category from the same latest activity fact.
Repeated and updated observations for one tool-call identifier do not inflate counts after Session reload; rejected stale-binding observations do not mutate the summary.
Focused reducer and Session grain persistence/reload tests pass using fakes and deterministic time, with no real Runtime, filesystem, or wall-clock assertions.
tasks.output: Persisted AgentSession activity-summary state, incremental reducer, grain write-path integration, and focused Session tests.
tasks.notes: Keep the summary inside AgentSession State JSON; no EF migration, transcript backfill, or activity-read fallback is part of this task.

tasks.title: Serve activity cards from persisted Session summaries
tasks.description: Switch the AgentOps activity assembler to map each card's eventSummary from the Session summary delivered by T-001. Remove the batch transcript-summary reduction while preserving preview, reconciliation, issue-title, workflow-progress, waiting-card, response-schema, canonical-route, and alias-route behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Both activity routes return card eventSummary values equivalent to the persisted Session summary and remain equivalent for the same project and limit.
Existing activity-card selection, ordering, limits, preview, usage, agent attribution, waiting cards, and workflow progress remain unchanged.
The activity summary path does not load or reduce transcript parts to build eventSummary, and amplification.transcriptRecords excludes that removed work.
AgentOps/API and amplification specs pass with controlled transcript history using operation counters rather than elapsed-time assertions.
tasks.output: Activity feed assembled from persisted summaries, updated amplification accounting, and AgentOps/Session spec coverage.
tasks.notes: Transcript detail endpoints and latest-activity preview remain transcript-backed; this task removes only the duplicate summary reduction.
